:::{#exr-var-mse-bias}
#### Squared standard error from MSE and bias

Using @thm-mse-bias-variance,
write the squared [standard error](#def-SE) $\sqf{\SE{\hth}}$
in terms of the [mean squared error](#def-mse) and the [bias](#def-bias) of $\hth$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-var-mse-bias}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hth} &= \sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \Var{\hth}
&& \text{(MSE equals bias squared plus variance)}\\
\Var{\hth} &= \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&& \text{(subtract $\sqf{\bias{\hth}}$ from both sides)}\\
\sqf{\SD{\hth}} &= \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&& \text{($\Var{\hth} = \sqf{\SD{\hth}}$)}\\
\sqf{\SE{\hth}} &= \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&& \text{(definition of standard error: $\SE{\hth} = \SD{\hth}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
